status: rejected exploratory integration; no production dispatch
method: Three interleaved process rounds for each GL T720 scalar-synthesis geometry. Each worker used identical deterministic f32 fixtures, reusable plan/workspace, warm calls, and 25 ms calibrated batches. Ratios are screening ranges, not confidence intervals or acceptance evidence.

source.note: After the screen, the isolated worktree changed only a Clippy expectation attribute and a test-only assertion in an ignored decomposition probe. The example worker binary was rebuilt; runtime behavior is unchanged, but its post-screen hash is recorded separately.
